세이셸의 코코 드 메르에서 출발한 이름, 그리고 Connect Code: A name that begins with the Coco-de-Mer of the Seychelles, and with Connect Code of intrinsic Merit. The COCODEMER story, its materials, and a promise designed as a sequence.
The name COCODEMER carries two meanings at once.
하나는 세이셸의 코코 드 메르(Coco-de-Mer)입니다. 유네스코 자: One is the Coco-de-Mer of the Seychelles — a rare palm protected as a UNESCO World Heritage species. Its seed is where our proprietary material, L-CODEMAR ELIXIR™, began.
다른 하나는 Connect Code of intrinsic Merit —: The other is Connect Code of intrinsic Merit — the code that connects intrinsic worth.
희소한 식물에서 출발해 피부가 받아들이는 형태로 설계하고 그 사이를 잇는: To begin with a rare plant, design it into a form the skin will take, and connect the two. That single sentence is what COCODEMER does.
세이셸에서 출발한 원료: A material that begins in the Seychelles
코코 드 메르는 세이셸 제도에만 자생하는 야자로, 세계에서 가장 큰 씨앗: The Coco-de-Mer grows only in the Seychelles and bears the largest seed in the world. It takes years to ripen, in an environment that has barely changed — and it is where this brand starts.
천연 아미노산이 풍부한 이 열매를 모방해, 식물 원료를 기반으로 한 독자: Modelled on that seed, which is rich in naturally occurring amino acids, we built L-CODEMAR ELIXIR™ — a proprietary technology on a botanical base. Multi-layer nano-gel emulsion encapsulation holds the core actives stable, and a liposomal form that mirrors the structure of skin carries them further in.
좋은 성분을 많이 넣는 것만으로는 피부가 달라지지 않습니다. 어떤 상태의: Loading in more good ingredients is not what changes skin. What decides the result is the state the skin is in, and the order in which things go on.
그래서 코코드메르는 제품을 나열하는 대신 순서를 설계했습니다. 피부를 정: So rather than list products, we designed a sequence: prepare the skin (Reset), deliver the actives (Boost), then hold that condition in place (Keep). Each stage has a technology of its own, so that every stage creates the conditions for the one after it.
